name: synthra-vscode
description: Starts Synthra's context engine automatically when you open a project — no more typing `syn .`. Works in VS Code, Antigravity, Cursor, and other VS Code-compatible editors.

synthra.autoStart.description: Start Synthra automatically when a folder containing a Synthra project is opened.

synthra.requireExistingProject.description: Only auto-start in folders Synthra already knows (they have a .synthra-graph/ or .synthra/ directory). Turn this off to auto-start in every folder you open — including ones where you have never run `syn .`.

synthra.path.description: Path to the `syn` executable. Leave as `syn` if it is on your PATH.

synthra.showDashboardNotification.description: Show a notification with the dashboard link each time Synthra starts. Off by default — the status bar already shows it.

synthra.healthCheckMinutes.description: How often to re-check Synthra's health while it runs (the status bar turns yellow or red when something is wrong). 0 turns polling off; a check still runs at start and when the window regains focus. The health light needs Synthra 0.32+.

synthra.checkForUpdates.description: Check npm for a newer Synthra once per window and offer to install it. The CLI's own update prompt can't appear under the extension, so without this you are never told.
